title: Primitive completeness C6: Vec completeness — pop/insert/remove/contains, Vec<String>/Vec<struct> (non-Copy elements), Vec::new()-no-param wrapper bug

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (78d6f77 + #99 fix e51593f). Vec completeness: pop_last/last/insert/remove/contains (tuple-free, OOB->L0, contains a real two-directional scan); non-Copy Vec<T> via a borrow-returning get(&self,i)->&T (vstd index moves a non-Copy elem -> the borrow fixes E0507) -> Vec<String> 17 verified, Vec<struct> 7, nested Vec<Vec<u64>> 15; the Vec::new()-no-param reachability fix (the #86 analog). Critic caught #99 (push dropped the element-preservation frame -> a >=2-elem accumulator lost its elements at the contract level) -> fixed (the forall|j| frame restored, load-bearing). 595 tests. Spillover: nested needs  (space) —  lexes as shift (minor lexer follow-up). Unblocks split->Vec<String> for the parser.
